paite: Huai a kipan Negeb gam lam zuan in Abraham akisuan a, Kadesh leh Shur kho kikal ah ateng a, Gerar ah hun bang tan hiam a-om tadih hi.
heading: Abraham Leh Abimelek
english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

paite: Abraham in azi Sarah, "Ka sanggamnu ahi,” achi hi. Gerar kumpipa Abimelek in mi asawl a, Sarah ava pisak hi.
english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

paite: Himahleh, zan in amanglam in Abimelek kiang ah Pathian ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na numei pi ziak in misi leltak na hita, amah lah mi zi ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

paite: Abimelek in anaih nai tadih kei hi, "Toupa, nam diktat na that hial dia hia?"
english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

paite: Amah mah in ka kiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu ahi," chi in; amah ngei in leng ka sanggampa ahi, achih behlap ngal a. "Lungtang hoihtak pu leh khut siangthoutak nei kawm a hiai bang ka hih ahi," achi hi.
english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

paite: Pathian in amang in, "Ahi, hiai lungtang hoihtak pu kawm a na hih ahi chih ka thei, ke'n leng ka tung a na khelh ding ka hon kham hi. Huaiziak in amah na khoih ka phal louh ahi.
english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

paite: Tu in huai mi zi pekik in; amah lah zawlnei ahi ngal a. Ahon thumsak ding a, na dam ding. Na piakkik keileh, na si ngeingei ding chih thei in; nang leh na neih tengteng toh," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

paite: Abimelek beltak in athou a, asikha tengteng asam a, azak ding un huai thu tengteng ahilh a, mite'n alau mahmah uhi.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

paite: Abimelek in Abraham asam a, akiang ah, "Ka tung ua na thilhih bangchidan ahia oi? Bang lam ah ahia na tung a ka khelh a, kei leh ka lalgam tung a thil gilou thupitak na hon tut? Thil hih tuak louhtak ka tung ah na hihta," achi hi.
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

paite: Abimelek mah in Abraham kiang ah, "Bang na mu a, hichibang a thil hih na maizen a?" achi nawn hi.
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

paite: Abraham in, "Hiai khua a Pathian launa himhim om lou a, ka zi ziak in ahon that mai ding uh, chih ka ngaihtuah ziak a hiai bang a na gamtang mah ka hi.
english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

paite: Huai lou in ka sanggamnu leng ahi him a, ka pa tanu ahi a, ka nu tanu bel ahi kei. Himahleh amah ka zi ahong hita hi.
english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in ka pa inn a kipan ahon vakvaihsak lai in akiang ah, 'Hiai na hehpihna ka tung a na lahsak ding ahi. Ka tunna peuh uah, ka sanggampa ahi hon chi zel in' ka chi him hi,” achi hi.
english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

paite: Abimelek in belamte, bawng-talte, sikhapate leh sikhanute pi in Abraham kiang ah apia a, azi Sarah leng apekikta hi.
english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

paite: Abimelek in, "En in, na ma ah ka gam zapi a-om, na utna peuh ah teng in," achi hi.
english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

paite: Sarah kiang ah, "En in, na sanggampa dangka sangkhat ka peta hi. Ngai in, na kiang a om tengteng leh nangmah a ding in amah na mit khuhna ahi ding. Hiai bang in amah taihilh in a-om hi."
english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

paite: Pathian kiang ah Abraham athum a, Pathian in Abimelek leh azi leh asikhanute adamsak nawn a, huchi in tate aneita uhi.
english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

paite: Abraham zi Sarah ziak in TOUPA'N Abimelek inkuante tengteng achiingsak vek ngal a.
english: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
